messages:
pagerduty: PagerDuty: INC-21200043 fired -> Service: model-catalog | Trigger: revision-mapping-failure | Severity: high | Affected: hosted + dedicated | Link: https://pd.example/INC-21200043
incident-bot: :rotating_light: incident created by pagerduty (INC-21200043). Escalation policy: oncall-rotation.
alice: acked oncall, looking
bob: I'm on it. seeing a spike of InvalidModelConfig errors in the catalog service logs, looks like 2 new model revisions promoted in last hour.
carol: can you paste the error?
bob: log snippet:
```
2026-03-14T09:12:03Z ERROR catalog.controller: failed to resolve tokenizer for model_id=redwood/open-xl revision=rev-2026-03-14-2 err=tokenizer_not_found
2026-03-14T09:12:03Z WARN catalog.router: fallback to default variant allowed=false route=prod
```
alice: customer-facing symptoms?
bob: [metrics] 5xx-rate for /v1/generate jumped from 0.2% -> 3.8% for the last 15m. Latency p95 for affected model up ~400ms. A handful of requests are returning structured error about tokenizer mismatch.
danielle: CS reporting two enterprise customers hit with invalid responses and timeouts, one opened a ticket (T-9872). They're asking for ETA.
carol: probable cause: the catalog promotion pipeline set a new default revision that relies on a tokenizer bundle not present on some inference clusters. Looks like the metadata key `tokenizer_bundle` is empty for that revision.
alice: can we route traffic to previous revision or variant immediately?
bob: yes. I'll start a routing override to send production traffic for model redwood/open-xl -> revision rev-2026-03-14-1 (previous stable). Doing via internal admin API.
bob: POST /admin/catalog/route-override {"model_id":"redwood/open-xl","route":"stable","override_revision":"rev-2026-03-14-1","ttl":600}
carol: @bob keep me posted. I'll start a quick rollback on the promotion pipeline and mark the revision as quarantined.
incident-bot: action recorded: routing-override by bob (tx 0x7f9b).
bob: override applied, traffic shifting now. monitoring...
alice: can someone check whether Dedicated customers using pinned revisions were affected?
carol: dedicated clusters unaffected — they use pinned revisions. Issue impacted the dynamic routing layer for hosted traffic and any unpinned dedicated pools.
danielle: telling CS to update customers: brief summary + workaround (we routed to previous revision). ETA for full fix?
bob: root cause: release job for rev-2026-03-14-2 omitted tokenizer artifact due to S3 permission error during publish. Fix options: (1) republish tokenizer artifact and re-promote revision, (2) keep routing override until we republish, (3) add a schema validation block in CI to prevent promotion without tokenizer_bundle.
alice: immediate mitigation = keep override + republish artifact. Who can republish?
bob: I can republish now if someone can grant temporary S3 key or confirm it's a permissions error.
carol: ops, do we have temporary credentials? @alice can you approve?
alice: approving temporary grant, ops team please rotate after.
carol: noted. I'll also open a fix PR to add validation (low risk) and trigger a canary.
incident-bot: pagerduty: INC-21200043 auto-escalation to second-level after 6m as not acknowledged by primary? (timestamped)
alice: acked and assigned to bob & carol.
danielle: crafting customer note now: "We detected an invalid model revision promotion causing tokenization errors for a small subset of requests. We've routed traffic to the previous stable revision and are republishing the tokenizer artifact. We'll follow up once fully resolved."
bob: republish started: `ci/publish-tokenizer --model redwood/open-xl --rev rev-2026-03-14-2`
bob: publish logs: 
```
[09:24:11] uploading tokenizer.tar.gz -> s3://model-artifacts/redwood/open-xl/rev-2026-03-14-2/tokenizer.tar.gz
[09:24:12] error: AccessDenied: PutObject
[09:24:12] retrying with service account role
[09:24:15] success
```
alice: after republish, can we re-run a small smoke test against the revision in a canary pool before flipping?
carol: yes. I'll spin a canary pool in us-west2 with 5 instances.
bob: republish successful. pushing metadata update to catalog: PATCH /catalog/models/redwood/open-xl/rev-2026-03-14-2 {"tokenizer_bundle":"s3://.../tokenizer.tar.gz"}
carol: metadata PATCH applied. Starting smoke jobs (20 queries) against canary.
bob: smoke tests all green. No tokenizer mismatch errors on canary.
carol: promoting revision back to default now with controlled rollout (10% -> 50% -> 100%).
incident-bot: action recorded: promotion-retry by carol.
alice: rolling at 10% now. watch metrics for errors and 5xx.
danielle: update to customers sent: "We've routed traffic to previous revision during mitigation. We're performing a controlled re-promotion after republishing the tokenizer. No user data was leaked. Expected full restoration within 30 minutes."
bob: at 10% no errors. at 50% still clean. increasing to 100%.
carol: full rollout complete. Monitoring 5xx back to baseline.
alice: closing PD incident once we confirm no regressions for 30m.
incident-bot: pagerduty: INC-21200043 status: resolved by alice. Resolution note: republished tokenizer artifact, applied catalog metadata, performed controlled re-promotion.
danielle: follow-up action items: - postmortem draft (owner: carol) - CI validation for tokenizer_bundle (owner: bob) - ops rotate temporary keys (owner: alice).
carol: I'll start postmortem draft in #postmortems and include timeline + customer impact numbers.
alice: thanks team. great quick coordination. :clap:
